crossRefs.note: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
crossRefs.keyword: That which, etc. Heb. Justice, justice

crossRefs.note: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
crossRefs.keyword: That which, etc. Heb. Justice, justice

crossRefs.note: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things…
crossRefs.keyword: That which, etc. Heb. Justice, justice

crossRefs.note: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
“But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord…
For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

translations.web: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
translations.bsb: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
translations.kjv: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth
translations.asv: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
